name: Duel Arena
author: DecompRecomp
description: Puts DUEL ARENA (the game's 2P DUEL) first on the title and hides TRADE. The decks come from the remote play pages (tools/remote-play) or the file MEMORIES_ARENA_DECKS names; a side with one needs no save, and with MEMORIES_ARENA=1 the title goes to the duel by itself (notes/duel-arena.md). play-arena.bat and play-arena.sh turn all of it on.
